CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "honua".agent_workspace_identities (
    workspace_id   TEXT COLLATE "C" PRIMARY KEY CHECK (workspace_id ~ '^[0-9a-f]{32}$'),
    owner_actor_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(owner_actor_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 1024),
    target_id      TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(target_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
    tenant_id      TEXT,
    created_at     TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
)
COMMENT ON TABLE "honua".agent_workspace_identities IS 'Immutable human owner, tenant and target for native local process workspace grants.'
